title: Deduplicate project setup .gitignore guards during install/init
description: After installing Boreal in boreal-work, .gitignore contains both memory/ and /memory/ plus existing memory runtime ignore rules. Init should avoid duplicate or equivalent guard patterns and keep the generated block tidy.
acceptanceCriteria: Project setup recognizes equivalent existing ignore patterns before appending new guards.
Repeated init/install runs do not duplicate memory, .boreal/project.json, or .boreal/runtime ignore rules.
Tests cover idempotent .gitignore updates for fresh and pre-populated files.
closedReason: Equivalent .gitignore guards no longer duplicate and tests cover idempotent setup.
